basis: Three new advisories published 2026-09-29 matching pinned versions; hosted run 36615251941 correctly failed closed (REGRESSION) because the immutable 2026-09-23 register could not know them. advisories.summary: Oauthlib: unsafe JSONP callback injection in RevocationEndpoint allows arbitrary JavaScript response generation
advisories.runtime_disposition_evidence: frappe@988e54f3 integrations/oauth2.py:189-202: frappe.integrations.oauth2.revoke_token discards the oauthlib-generated revocation response entirely (frappe.local.response = frappe._dict({}); only http_status_code is forwarded). The injected response content that this advisory exploits can never reach a client; the endpoint is also POST-only. Pinned-tree source trace in advisory-delta-2026-09-29/README.md.
advisories.fix_path: Official Frappe v16 release carrying oauthlib >= 4.0.0 (EXTERNAL/UPSTREAM BLOCKED, unchanged)

advisories.summary: Oauthlib: timing attack in PKCE code_verifier comparison (CWE-208)
advisories.runtime_disposition_evidence: frappe@988e54f3 oauth.py:87-89 and 144-165: frappe implements its own PKCE storage and verification (sha256/base64url of code_verifier compared to the stored code_challenge) and never invokes oauthlib's PKCE verification path that this advisory covers. Pinned-tree source trace in advisory-delta-2026-09-29/README.md. Residual note recorded there: frappe's own compare is a plain string equality; that is a distinct, non-advisory observation, not this advisory.
advisories.fix_path: Official Frappe v16 release carrying oauthlib >= 4.0.0 (EXTERNAL/UPSTREAM BLOCKED, unchanged)

advisories.summary: PyJWT: malformed RSA JWK aborts parsing of an entire JWK Set
advisories.runtime_disposition_evidence: The vulnerable code path is PyJWKSet/JWKS parsing. Pinned frappe@988e54f3 contains no PyJWKSet/PyJWKSClient import or instantiation anywhere (repository-wide source search); every jwt use is encode/decode with explicit keys (oauth.py:304, 441, 520; utils/oauth.py:179), and jwks_uri exists solely as an unbound Social Login Key type hint (integrations/utils.py:45). No operator flow, bootstrap, product packaging, or launcher in this repository configures a JWKS-based social login. Pinned-tree source trace in advisory-delta-2026-09-29/README.md.
advisories.fix_path: Official Frappe v16 release carrying pyjwt >= 2.14.0 (EXTERNAL/UPSTREAM BLOCKED, unchanged)
